inj.note: Love was available to play Week 8 after missing the Cardinals' previous two games due to a left ankle issue, but he ended up exiting Sunday's 33-30 overtime win over the Cowboys late in the first quarter after tweaking his opposite ankle. Though the No. 3 overall pick in the 2026 NFL Draft was cleared to play in advance of Week 1 after previously sustaining a right high-ankle sprain in the preseason, he won't be as fortunate this time around now that he's sprained the same ankle for the second time in less than three months. The projected 4-to-5-week recovery timeline gives Love a chance at returning to action when first eligible to return from IR on Dec. 6 against the Eagles, but at least for the next four games, Tyler Allgeier looks poised to serve as Arizona's lead back. The Cardinals could also look to bring James Conner (foot) back from IR at some point during that four-game stretch.

news.h: Sources: Cardinals' Jeremiyah Love to IR, out 4-5 weeks with high ankle sprain
news.d: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love is headed to IR because of a high ankle sprain that will sideline the rookie for 4-5 weeks.

news.h: Cardinals' Mike LaFleur: Jeremiyah Love's injury to 'new portion' of his ankle
news.d: Cardinals rookie running back Jeremiyah Love suffered a new ankle injury in Sunday's win over the Cowboys, coach Mike LaFleur said.

news.h: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) set to return
news.d: Jeremiyah Love is expected to return to the field for the Cardinals on Sunday after missing the past two weeks with an ankle injury.

news.h: Cards rookie RB Jeremiyah Love to miss second straight game with ankle injury
news.d: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love will miss his second straight game Sunday as he continues to recover from an ankle injury.
